### Root Cause
In [`UnboundedFifoBuffer`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/collections_8_group_a_blind/src/java/org/apache/commons/collections/buffer/UnboundedFifoBuffer.java), [`readObject`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/collections_8_group_a_blind/src/java/org/apache/commons/collections/buffer/UnboundedFifoBuffer.java#L130-L140) previously allocated the underlying buffer array as `new Object[size + 1]`. When deserializing an empty buffer (`size == 0`), the allocated buffer had length 1. During subsequent [`add(Object)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/collections_8_group_a_blind/src/java/org/apache/commons/collections/buffer/UnboundedFifoBuffer.java#L175-L200) operations, buffer resizing calculates new capacity as `((buffer.length - 1) * 2) + 1`, which for length 1 evaluated to 1 (`((1 - 1) * 2) + 1 = 1`). This prevented buffer expansion, causing index wrapping (`tail` wrapping back to 0) and resulting in a reported `size()` of 0 instead of 1.

### Solution
1. In [`writeObject`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/collections_8_group_a_blind/src/java/org/apache/commons/collections/buffer/UnboundedFifoBuffer.java#L115-L122), serialize `buffer.length` after `size()`.
2. In [`readObject`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/collections_8_group_a_blind/src/java/org/apache/commons/collections/buffer/UnboundedFifoBuffer.java#L130-L141), read the serialized `buffer.length` and allocate `new Object[length]`.
3. Saved the focused diff to [`blind_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/collections_8_group_a_blind/blind_fix.patch).
